name: Oficina — Tech Challenge Fase 3
description: Os três painéis exigidos pelo PDF da Fase 3, mais latência e saúde. Importar em New Relic → Dashboards → Import dashboard, e trocar ACCOUNT_ID pelo id da conta.

widgets.title: Volume diário de ordens de serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS abertas' FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND req.method = 'POST' AND req.url = '/os' AND res.statusCode = 201 TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT average(duracaoSegundos) / 60 AS 'Minutos' FROM Log WHERE event = 'os.status.transicao' FACET statusAnterior SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event IN ('os.processamento.falha', 'requisicao.falha') FACET event TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Transições de status ao longo do tempo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'os.status.transicao' FACET statusNovo TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT timestamp, correlationId, url, statusCode, `exception.message` FROM Log WHERE event IN ('os.processamento.falha', 'requisicao.falha') LIMIT 50 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'oficina-api%' TIMESERIES SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND res.statusCode IS NOT NULL FACET res.statusCode TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT average(responseTime) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND responseTime IS NOT NULL FACET req.url SINCE 6 hours ago LIMIT 10
SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) AS 'CPU (cores)', average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1e6 AS 'Memória (MB)' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'oficina-api' TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago
